# Decay Labs

> A hand-illustrated archive of 1,000 Subjects created on Base, with the Half-Life Archive lore and transparent build documentation.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://decaylabs.online/): project overview and current build proof.
- [Lore](https://decaylabs.online/lore): the Half-Life Archive story arcs and chapter hooks.
- [Collection](https://decaylabs.online/collection): the curated archive and Subject lookup.
- [Trust](https://decaylabs.online/trust): contract, inventory, storage, and safety disclosures.
- [FAQ](https://decaylabs.online/faq): plain-language answers.
- [Links](https://decaylabs.online/links): official destinations.

## Project facts

- The collection contains 1,000 hand-illustrated Subjects.
- The project is on Base; media and metadata are referenced through IPFS.
- Factions and memory fragments are narrative classifications, not rarity or price claims.
- There is no active mint, whitelist, or surprise airdrop.
- Games, staking, tokens, and financial returns are not represented as delivered or promised.
